# Community Rule Column 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 3 | **Condition:** complete

---

**3:1** He-shall-not-be-reckoned-righteous who-walks in-the-stubbornness-of his-heart, for-darkness he-regards-as the-ways-of-light. In-the-spring-of
**3:2** the-perfect he-shall-not-be-counted. He-shall-not-be-purified by-atonement-offerings, and-he-shall-not-be-made-clean by-the-waters-of-purification,
**3:3** and-he-shall-not-sanctify-himself in-seas and-rivers, and-he-shall-not-be-made-clean by-any waters-of-washing. Unclean, unclean
**3:4** shall-he-be all the-days that-he-rejects the-ordinances-of God, not-being-instructed in-the-community-of His-counsel.
**3:5** For by-the-spirit-of the-counsel-of the-truth-of God are-the-ways-of a-man atoned, all
**3:6** his-iniquities, so-that-he-may-gaze upon-the-light-of life; and-by-the-spirit-of holiness of-the-community, in-His-truth,
**3:7** he-is-cleansed from-all his-iniquities; and-by-the-spirit-of uprightness and-humility his-sin is-atoned;
**3:8** and-by-the-submission-of his-soul to-all the-statutes-of God his-flesh is-cleansed,
**3:9** to-be-sprinkled with-the-waters-of-purification and-to-sanctify-himself with-the-waters-of-cleanness. And-he-shall-establish his-steps
**3:10** to-walk in-perfection in-all the-ways-of God, as He-commanded for-His-appointed-times;
**3:11** and-not-to-turn-aside to-the-right or-to-the-left, and-not-to-transgress against-any-one
**3:12** of-all His-words. Then he-shall-be-accepted by-pleasing atonements before-God, and-it-shall-be for-him a-covenant-of
**3:13** the-everlasting community.
**3:14** For-the-Instructor, to-instruct and-to-teach all the-Sons-of-Light concerning-the-nature
**3:15** of-all the-sons-of-man, according-to all the-kinds-of their-spirits with-their-signs, concerning-their-deeds
**3:16** in-their-generations, and-concerning-the-visitation-of their-afflictions together-with the-appointed-times-of their-reward.
**3:17** From-the-God-of knowledge is all that-is and-that-shall-be, and-before they-existed He-established all their-design.
**3:18** And-when-they-exist for-their-appointed-times, according-to His-glorious design they-fulfill their-works,
**3:19** and-nothing is-to-be-changed. In-His-hand are-the-ordinances-of all, and-He sustains-them in-all their-needs.
**3:20** And-He created man for-the-dominion-of the-world, and-He-appointed for-him two-spirits
**3:21** to-walk in-them until-the-appointed-time-of His-visitation: they-are the-spirits-of
**3:22** truth and-of-deceit. In-a-spring-of-light are-the-origins-of truth, and-from-a-well-of
**3:23** darkness are-the-origins-of deceit. In-the-hand-of the-Prince-of-Lights is-the-dominion over-all
**3:24** the-sons-of-righteousness; in-the-ways-of-light they-walk. And-in-the-hand-of the-Angel-of
**3:25** Darkness is-all the-dominion over-the-sons-of-deceit; and-in-the-ways-of-darkness they-walk.
**3:26** And-by-the-Angel-of-Darkness is-the-straying-of all the-sons-of-righteousness, and-all their-sins and-their-iniquities and-their-guilt and-the-transgressions-of their-deeds are-under-his-dominion

---
*EMET notes: Column 3 transitions from the covenant ceremony to the theological treatise on the Two Spirits (3:13ff). "Maskil" (3:14) rendered "Instructor" — a technical title for the community's teacher. The dualism of "spirit of truth" and "spirit of deceit" (ruach emet/ruach avel, 3:18-19) is foundational to Qumran theology. "Prince of Lights" (sar ha-me'orot, 3:20) and "Angel of Darkness" (mal'akh ha-choshekh, 3:21) are preserved as titles. The construct chain "spring of light" (ma'yan 'or) parallels "well of darkness" (meqor choshekh). Line 3:26 continues into Column 4.*
